title: Fire Blade
description: This will add a custom sword that will grant you explosive and fire powers...
body:
The Fire Blade mod is a combat-enhancing addition for Minecraft Forge 1.20.1 that introduces a powerful new weapon to your arsenal. Designed to fit seamlessly into the game's progression, it provides a specialized tool for players looking to upgrade their weaponry beyond standard options.

Key Features
The Fire Blade: Adds a unique sword that is fully compatible with standard combat mechanics and enchantments like Sharpness and Sweeping Edge.

Custom Crafting: Includes its own dedicated recipe that will allow you to craft it as you collect materials.

Thematic Design: Features custom 16x16 textures and item models to ensure the weapon looks as powerful as it feels.

Optimized Performance: Built using MixinExtras for maximum compatibility with other mods in your Forge environment.
